incident-bot: PAGER: smart-routing service detected repeated fallback loops for requests originating from eu-west-1 -> region-fallback -> model-variant rotate. Error rate spike at 15:01 UTC, ~3x baseline for hosted text-generation endpoints. Paging primary on-call.
Maya (oncall): ack, I'm on it. pinging SRE + ML triage. anyone seen customer pages? :eyes:
Jess Support: getting 3 customers reporting increased 503s and slow responses (payments, chat). I have ticket IDs but will share after triage.
Alice SRE: quick triage: graphs show continuous increases in "fallback_count" and a looped redirect metric: requests are being routed eu-west-1 -> eu-central-1 -> eu-west-1 repeatedly for compatible-variant lookup. stack traces show routing-service returning "no-compatible-variant" then fallback policy triggers region fallback which again tries same incompatible variant.
Alice SRE: core symptom looks like routing policy thinks the quantized variant supports tool_call, but our model-compat matrix marks it incompatible — mismatch is causing policy to not select the fp16 variant, so it falls regions trying other variants and loops.
Sam ML: confirming — we recently onboarded model id model-quant-2 with a stubbed compat flag. metadata incorrectly set tool_call: true and context_window: 4096. In reality quantized build lacks tool_call and max_ctx 2048. So smart-routing tries to route to quantized variant for tool_call-enabled requests -> fails compatibility check later -> fallbacks.
Devon (dev-platform): concrete mitigation options:
- Option A (fast): disable "smart_fallback_policy" at control-plane level for hosted tier in eu-west-1 until we correct compat flags. Command:

```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/policies/disable" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $CTRL_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"policy":"smart_fallback","scope":"region:eu-west-1,service:hosted"}'
```

- Option B (safer): patch compatibility registry to force model-quant-2.tool_call=false and max_ctx=2048, then reload routing cache.

PATCH example:
```
PATCH /models/metadata/model-quant-2
{"compat":{"tool_call":false,"max_ctx":2048}}
```

We should do A immediately to stop customer impact, then B as the fix.
Maya (oncall): doing option A now. will also open a short-term route pin to fp16 variant for tool_call routes.
Devon (dev-platform): steps to pin:
```
POST /routing/overrides
{"match":{"capability":"tool_call","region":"eu-west-1"},"force_variant":"model-fp16-1","ttl":3600}
```

This forces tool_call traffic to known-compatible variant.
Alice SRE: I'm seeing fall in 503s already after disable. latency still elevated for some requests but loop broken. good.
Jess Support: informing impacted customers that we've mitigated the loop and are applying a fix. ticket updates sent. :thumbsup:
Sam ML: I'll push the compat registry patch and run a reload of the routing cache. Preparing commit now.
devops-note: deploy-bot: Deploy started: registry/compat-patch@rev-2a7f
deploy-bot: CI passed, applying to canary in eu-west-1
deploy-bot: canary OK -> rolling to region
Sam ML: patch applied, compatibility flags now reflect tool_call=false and max_ctx=2048 for model-quant-2. routing cache reload triggered.
Alice SRE: verifying: queries that require tool_call are now routed directly to model-fp16-1. quantized variant still used for non-tool_call requests in same region. no more falls.
Maya (oncall): customer impact window ~15:01-15:22 UTC. severity downgraded to sev3. Postmortem owner assigned: Sam ML + Devon.
Jess Support: confirmed with customers, two still saw transient failures but all have acknowledged mitigation notes.
Maya (oncall): handing off to Ben (next oncall) for monitoring and postmortem follow-up. summary:
- root cause: compatibility registry had incorrect flags for quantized model (tool_call true, max_ctx too large)
- impact: smart-routing fallback loop across eu regions causing elevated 503s/latency for tool_call flows
- mitigation: disabled smart_fallback policy for eu-west-1, pinned tool_call routes to fp16 variant, patched registry, reloaded routing cache
- action items: add a pre-onboard compat verification test for tool_call/context, add a canary check to routing cache reloads, alert if fallback_count > threshold
Ben (oncall): ack and taking over, will run 1hr watch and ensure pager quiet. assigning postmortem doc to Sam ML. :white_check_mark:
Maya (oncall): adding notes to incident channel and creating postmortem stub.
Alice SRE: logs and graphs archived under incident/1990000472 folder. will attach to postmortem.
Sam ML: follow-up will include a small unit test in model-registry CI to assert declared capabilities match actual build artifacts (tool_call, ctx). ETA EOD.
Ben (oncall): thanks team. I'll escalate if anything reappears. closing the live incident thread but keeping thread in channel for postmortem edits.
